exercises.question: 0.10 kg of water at 80°C is mixed with 0.30 kg of water at 20°C. Find the mixture temperature. Neglect the cup.
steps: Both liquids are water, so c cancels, but the masses differ.
θ = (m1 θ1 + m2 θ2) / (m1 + m2) because c1 = c2.
θ = 14.0 / 0.40 = 35°C, closer to 20°C because that portion has the larger mass.

summary: The final temperature of two bodies that only exchange heat is a weighted average of their initial temperatures. The weights are the heat capacities mc. It is the plain average only when those heat capacities are equal.
